intermediate.uzDef: faqat yomon yangiliklarni o'qish va ko'rish odati, bu stressni oshiradi.
intermediate.ex: I spent hours doomscrolling last night and now I feel terrible.
intermediate.exUz: Men kecha tuni bilan soatlab yomon xabarlarni o'qib chiqdim va endi o'zimni juda yomon his qilyapman.

intermediate.uzDef: texnologiyadan vaqtincha voz kechish, masalan smartfon, kompyuter va ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan.
intermediate.ex: I'm planning a digital detox for the weekend to disconnect and relax.
intermediate.exUz: Men dam olish kunlarida raqamli detoks qilishni rejalashtiryapman, aloqani uzib, dam olish uchun.

intermediate.uzDef: shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni o'g'irlash maqsadida soxta elektron pochta orqali aldash.
intermediate.ex: Be careful of phishing scams that ask for your bank details.
intermediate.exUz: Bank ma'lumotlaringizni so'ragan firibgarliklardan ehtiyot bo'ling.

intermediate.uzDef: internetda tez tarqalib, ko'p odamlar tomonidan ko'rilish.
intermediate.ex: The video of the cat playing the piano went viral overnight.
intermediate.exUz: Pianino chalayotgan mushukning videosi bir kechada tarqalib ketdi.

intermediate.uzDef: kompyuter va internet ma'lumotlarini himoya qilish tizimi.
intermediate.ex: Cybersecurity is a major concern for all companies nowadays.
intermediate.exUz: Kiberxavfsizlik hozirgi kunda barcha kompaniyalar uchun katta muammo.

intermediate.uzDef: texnologiyalarni yaxshi tushunuvchi va mohirlik bilan ishlatuvchi.
intermediate.ex: You need to be tech-savvy to work in this field.
intermediate.exUz: Bu sohada ishlash uchun siz texnologiyalardan xabardor bo'lishingiz kerak.

intermediate.uzDef: internetdagi shaxsiy yoki biznes profil, veb-sayt, ijtimoiy tarmoqlardagi faollik.
intermediate.ex: It's important to maintain a professional online presence.
intermediate.exUz: Professional onlayn mavjudlikni saqlash muhim.

intermediate.uzDef: internetda qoldirilgan ma'lumotlar, xabarlar, rasmlar va boshqa narsalar.
intermediate.ex: Think carefully about your digital footprint before posting anything online.
intermediate.exUz: Onlaynda biror narsa joylashtirishdan oldin raqamli izingiz haqida yaxshilab o'ylab ko'ring.

intermediate.uzDef: ekrandagi ma'lumotlarni tezda ko'rish uchun yuqoriga yoki pastga siljitish.
intermediate.ex: I often scroll through social media when I'm bored.
intermediate.exUz: Zerikkanimda ko'pincha ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni varaqlayman.

intermediate.uzDef: saytga yoki dasturga foydalanuvchi nomi va parol bilan kirish.
intermediate.ex: Don't forget to log in to your account before starting work.
intermediate.exUz: Ishni boshlashdan oldin hisobingizga kirishni unutmang.

intermediate.uzDef: xizmat, dastur yoki saytga a'zo bo'lish uchun ro'yxatdan o'tish jarayoni.
intermediate.ex: You need to sign up for an account to use this app.
intermediate.exUz: Bu ilovani ishlatish uchun siz hisob yaratib, ro'yxatdan o'tishingiz kerak.

intermediate.uzDef: internet, telefon yoki ijtimoiy tarmoqlar orqali doimiy aloqada bo'lish.
intermediate.ex: Social media helps people stay connected with friends and family.
intermediate.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar odamlarga do'stlari va oilasi bilan aloqada bo'lishga yordam beradi.

intermediate.uzDef: internetda umumiy manfaatlar asosida birlashgan odamlar guruhi.
intermediate.ex: I found a supportive online community for writers.
intermediate.exUz: Men yozuvchilar uchun qo'llab-quvvatlovchi onlayn jamoa topdim.

intermediate.uzDef: ishlatish oson, tushunarli interfeysga ega.
intermediate.ex: This app is very user-friendly, even for beginners.
intermediate.exUz: Bu ilova juda qulay, hatto yangi boshlanuvchilar uchun ham.

intermediate.uzDef: ma'lumotlarni uzatish tezligi yoki imkoniyati.
intermediate.ex: We need more bandwidth to stream videos smoothly.
intermediate.exUz: Videolarni muammosiz uzatish uchun bizga ko'proq o'tkazuvchanlik kerak.

intermediate.uzDef: ma'lumotlarni internetdagi serverda saqlash.
intermediate.ex: I use cloud storage to back up all my important files.
intermediate.exUz: Men barcha muhim fayllarimni zaxiralash uchun bulutli xotiradan foydalanaman.

intermediate.uzDef: eng zamonaviy, yangi va innovatsion texnologiya.
intermediate.ex: The company is developing cutting-edge AI technology.
intermediate.exUz: Kompaniya eng so'nggi sun'iy intellekt texnologiyasini ishlab chiqmoqda.

intermediate.uzDef: texnologiya bilan o'sgan avlod, texnologiyani yaxshi biluvchi.
intermediate.ex: Digital natives are comfortable using new technologies.
intermediate.exUz: Raqamli avlod yangi texnologiyalardan foydalanishda o'zini qulay his qiladi.

intermediate.uzDef: internetda xizmatlar taklif qiluvchi sayt yoki dastur.
intermediate.ex: YouTube is a popular online platform for sharing videos.
intermediate.exUz: YouTube - videolarni baham ko'rish uchun mashhur onlayn platforma.

intermediate.uzDef: kompyuter tomonidan yaratilgan sun'iy muhit.
intermediate.ex: Virtual reality is used in gaming and education.
intermediate.exUz: Virtual reallik o'yinlarda va ta'limda qo'llaniladi.

intermediate.uzDef: haqiqiy dunyoni kompyuter grafikasi bilan boyitish.
intermediate.ex: Augmented reality apps are becoming more common.
intermediate.exUz: Kengaytirilgan reallik ilovalari tobora keng tarqalmoqda.

intermediate.uzDef: shaxsiy ma'lumotlarning ruxsatsiz kirish natijasida o'g'irlanishi.
intermediate.ex: The company announced a data breach affecting millions of users.
intermediate.exUz: Kompaniya millionlab foydalanuvchilarga ta'sir qiluvchi ma'lumotlar buzilishi haqida e'lon qildi.

intermediate.uzDef: texnologiyaga kirish imkoniyatidagi tengsizlik.
intermediate.ex: We need to bridge the digital divide and provide access to technology for everyone.
intermediate.exUz: Biz raqamli tafovutni bartaraf etishimiz va hammaga texnologiyaga kirish imkoniyatini berishimiz kerak.

intermediate.uzDef: onlayn uchrashuvda yoki qo'ng'iroqda birovning ovozini o'chirish.
intermediate.ex: Could you mute yourself when you're not speaking?
intermediate.exUz: Gapirmayotganingizda ovozingizni o'chirib qo'yishingiz mumkinmi?

intermediate.uzDef: internet aloqasidan katta miqdordagi o'tkazuvchanlikni ishlatadigan dastur yoki faoliyat.
intermediate.ex: Streaming videos can be a real bandwidth hog.
intermediate.exUz: Videolarni oqimlash haqiqiy o'tkazuvchanlikni yeyuvchi bo'lishi mumkin.

intermediate.uzDef: birovni nozik, ammo salbiy tarzda tanqid qilish.
intermediate.ex: She threw shade at my new phone on social media.
intermediate.exUz: U ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda mening yangi telefonimni kinoya qildi.

intermediate.uzDef: texnologiyadan (telefon, kompyuter) vaqtincha uzoqlashish.
intermediate.ex: I need to unplug this weekend and just relax.
intermediate.exUz: Men dam olish kunlarida texnologiyadan uzoqlashib, dam olishim kerak.

intermediate.uzDef: internetdan tashqari, real hayotda.
intermediate.ex: We met online and then met IRL a few weeks later.
intermediate.exUz: Biz onlayn tanishdik va keyin bir necha hafta o'tgach haqiqiy hayotda uchrashdik.

intermediate.uzDef: yangi texnologiyalar yoki tendentsiyalardan xabardor emas.
intermediate.ex: I'm feeling a little behind the curve when it comes to new gadgets.
intermediate.exUz: Yangi gadjetlar haqida gap ketganda, men biroz ortda qolayotgandek his qilyapman.

intermediate.uzDef: o'rnatishni talab qilmaydigan, ulagandan so'ng darhol ishlaydigan.
intermediate.ex: This printer is plug and play, so it's easy to set up.
intermediate.exUz: Bu printer 'uladi va ishlat' turiga kiradi, shuning uchun uni o'rnatish oson.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Internetda shaxsiy qiziqishlarga mos keladigan ma'lumotlar bilan o'ralash
upper-intermediate.ex: It's hard to escape the filter bubble when social media algorithms only show you what you already agree with.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoq algoritmlari faqat siz rozi bo'lgan narsalarni ko'rsatganda, filtr pufagidan qochish qiyin.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Internet orqali ishlaydigan va joydan joyga ko'chib yuradigan shaxs
upper-intermediate.ex: Becoming a digital nomad was the best decision I ever made; I can work from anywhere!
upper-intermediate.exUz: Raqamli ko'chmanchi bo'lish men qabul qilgan eng yaxshi qaror edi; men har qanday joydan ishlashim mumkin!

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Bir mavzuga qiziqib, u haqida ko'p vaqt sarflash
upper-intermediate.ex: I started watching cat videos and ended up going down the rabbit hole of conspiracy theories.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Men mushuk videolarini tomosha qilishni boshladim va oxir-oqibat fitna nazariyalari chuquriga tushib qoldim.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Tez va qisqa vaqt ichida, juda tez
upper-intermediate.ex: That app became popular virtually overnight; everyone's using it now.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Bu ilova deyarli bir kechada mashhur bo'lib ketdi; hozir hamma undan foydalanmoqda.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Internetda tajovuzkor bo'lgan, lekin hayotda uyatchan shaxs
upper-intermediate.ex: Don't pay attention to keyboard warriors; they're just trying to get a reaction.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Klaviatura jangchilariga e'tibor bermang; ular shunchaki reaksiya olishga harakat qilishyapti.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Internetda tanishgan odamlarning haqiqiy hayotda uchrashuvi
upper-intermediate.ex: We're planning an IRL meetup for our online gaming group next month.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Biz keyingi oy onlayn o'yin guruhimiz uchun HAda uchrashuv rejalashtiryapmiz.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni haddan tashqari ko'p oshkor qilish
upper-intermediate.ex: I think she's oversharing on social media; everyone knows her business.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Menimcha, u ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda haddan tashqari ko'p ma'lumot oshkor qilmoqda; hamma uning ishlarini biladi.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Internet orqali video, musiqa yoki boshqa ma'lumotlarni uzatish
upper-intermediate.ex: I prefer to stream content rather than download it.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Men kontentni yuklab olishdan ko'ra translyatsiya qilishni afzal ko'raman.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Texnologiyalarga juda ko'p tayanadigan
upper-intermediate.ex: Our society has become so tech-dependent that we can't function without our devices.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Jamiyatimiz texnologiyaga shunchalik bog'liq bo'lib qoldiki, biz qurilmalarimizsiz ishlay olmaymiz.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Texnologiyalardan butunlay voz kechish
upper-intermediate.ex: Sometimes I just want to go off-grid and escape all the digital noise.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Ba'zan men shunchaki tarmoqdan uzilib, barcha raqamli shovqinlardan qochishni xohlayman.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda avtomatik ravishda harakat qiladigan dastur
upper-intermediate.ex: It's getting harder to tell the difference between real people and social bots online.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Internetda haqiqiy odamlar va ijtimoiy botlar o'rtasidagi farqni aniqlash tobora qiyinlashib bormoqda.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Fikrlarning faqat tasdiqlanishi muhiti
upper-intermediate.ex: Social media can become an echo chamber if you only follow people who agree with you.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Agar siz faqat sizga rozi bo'lgan odamlarni kuzatsangiz, ijtimoiy media akssado xonaga aylanishi mumkin.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Algoritmlar tomonidan yaratilgan tarafkashlik yoki adolatsizlik
upper-intermediate.ex: We need to be aware of algorithmic bias in AI systems.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Biz AI tizimlaridagi algoritmik tarafkashlikdan xabardor bo'lishimiz kerak.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Diqqat resurs sifatida baholanadigan tizim
upper-intermediate.ex: In the attention economy, companies are constantly fighting for our time and focus.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Diqqat iqtisodiyotida kompaniyalar doimo bizning vaqtimiz va e'tiborimiz uchun kurashmoqdalar.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Noto'g'ri harakatlari uchun odamlarni ommaviy qoralash
upper-intermediate.ex: Cancel culture can be harsh and unforgiving.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Bekor qilish madaniyati shafqatsiz va kechirmaydigan bo'lishi mumkin.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Texnologiyalardan sog'lom va muvozanatli foydalanish
upper-intermediate.ex: It's important to prioritize digital wellbeing and set boundaries with technology.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Raqamli farovonlikni ustuvor qilish va texnologiya bilan chegaralar belgilash muhim.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Internetda kontent yaratadigan shaxs
upper-intermediate.ex: She's a successful content creator on YouTube.
upper-intermediate.exUz: U YouTube'da muvaffaqiyatli kontent yaratuvchisi.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Raqamli texnologiyalardan samarali foydalanish qobiliyati
upper-intermediate.ex: Digital literacy is essential in today's world.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Raqamli savodxonlik bugungi kunda juda muhim.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Internetda provokatsiya qiladigan odam
upper-intermediate.ex: Don't feed the internet trolls; just ignore them.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Internet trollarini boqmang; shunchaki ularga e'tibor bermang.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Internet orqali ta'qib qilish
upper-intermediate.ex: Cyberbullying can have serious consequences.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Kiberbulling jiddiy oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda katta ta'sirga ega shaxs
upper-intermediate.ex: Social media influencers can have a big impact on consumer behavior.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoq ta'sir o'tkazuvchilari iste'molchilar xulq-atvoriga katta ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Internetda jonli video translyatsiya qilish
upper-intermediate.ex: I'm going live on Instagram later to talk about my new book.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Men keyinroq Instagramda yangi kitobim haqida gapirish uchun jonli efirga chiqaman.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni internetda himoya qilish
upper-intermediate.ex: Online privacy is a growing concern for many people.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Onlayn maxfiylik ko'pchilik uchun tobora dolzarb muammoga aylanib bormoqda.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Katta ma'lumotlar to'plamlaridan ma'lumot olish
upper-intermediate.ex: Companies use data mining to understand consumer behavior.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Kompaniyalar iste'molchilar xulq-atvorini tushunish uchun ma'lumot qazishdan foydalanadilar.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Internetga ulangan va turli funksiyalarni bajaradigan qurilma
upper-intermediate.ex: I have a smart device that controls the lights in my house.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Mening uyimdagi chiroqlarni boshqaradigan aqlli qurilmam bor.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Elektron pochta xabarlarini olishni to'xtatish
upper-intermediate.ex: I need to unsubscribe from all these newsletters.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Men bu barcha yangiliklardan obunani bekor qilishim kerak.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Hikoyaning muhim detallarini ochib berishdan oldin ogohlantirish
upper-intermediate.ex: Spoiler alert: Don't read this if you haven't seen the movie!
upper-intermediate.exUz: Buzg'unchi ogohlantirish: Agar filmni ko'rmagan bo'lsangiz, buni o'qimang!

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Ekran oldida o'tkazilgan vaqt
upper-intermediate.ex: I need to reduce my screen time and spend more time outdoors.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Men ekran vaqtimni qisqartirishim va ko'proq vaqtni tashqarida o'tkazishim kerak.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Odamlardan pul yig'ish orqali loyihani moliyalashtirish
upper-intermediate.ex: They're using crowdfunding to raise money for their startup.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Ular o'z startupi uchun pul yig'ish uchun ommaviy moliyalashtirishdan foydalanmoqdalar.

upper-intermediate.uzDef: Internetda jonli video ko'rsatish
upper-intermediate.ex: I watched the concert on livestream.
upper-intermediate.exUz: Men konsertni jonli translyatsiyada tomosha qildim.

advanced.uzDef: Texnologiyalar va internetning keng tarqalgan davri
advanced.ex: We're living in the digital age, where information is at our fingertips.
advanced.exUz: Biz raqamli davrda yashayapmiz, bu erda ma'lumotlar qo'limiz ostida.

advanced.uzDef: Simsiz internetga ulanish imkonini beruvchi joy
advanced.ex: I found a wireless hotspot at the cafe so I could check my email.
advanced.exUz: Men kafeda elektron pochtamni tekshirish uchun simsiz nuqta topdim.

advanced.ex: Online banking makes it easy to pay bills from home.
advanced.exUz: Onlayn bank uyda o'tirib to'lovlarni amalga oshirishni osonlashtiradi.

advanced.ex: The music industry has experienced significant digital disruption.
advanced.exUz: Musiqa sanoati sezilarli raqamli buzilishni boshdan kechirdi.

advanced.uzDef: Ovozli buyruqlarni bajaruvchi dastur yoki qurilma
advanced.ex: I use a virtual assistant to set reminders and play music.
advanced.exUz: Men eslatmalar o'rnatish va musiqa ijro etish uchun virtual yordamchidan foydalanaman.

advanced.uzDef: Internet orqali tovarlar va xizmatlarni sotish
advanced.ex: E-commerce has revolutionized the way we shop.
advanced.exUz: Elektron tijorat bizning xarid qilish usulimizni tubdan o'zgartirdi.

advanced.ex: The tech giants are investing heavily in artificial intelligence.
advanced.exUz: Texnologiya gigantlari sun'iy intellektga katta sarmoya kiritmoqdalar.

advanced.uzDef: Katta hajmdagi internet trafigini talab qiladigan
advanced.ex: Video streaming is a bandwidth-intensive activity.
advanced.exUz: Video oqim - bu trafigi yuqori faoliyat.

advanced.uzDef: Kompyuterlar va internet orqali sodir etiladigan jinoyatlar
advanced.ex: Cybercrime is a growing threat to businesses and individuals.
advanced.exUz: Kiberjinoyat korxonalar va shaxslar uchun o'sib borayotgan tahdiddir.

advanced.ex: Companies need to innovate to stay ahead in the market.
advanced.exUz: Kompaniyalar bozorda oldingi safda bo'lish uchun innovatsiyalar yaratishi kerak.

advanced.ex: She's a power user of Photoshop, so she can do amazing things.
advanced.exUz: U Photoshop dasturining tajribali foydalanuvchisi, shuning uchun u ajoyib narsalarni qila oladi.

advanced.ex: The Internet of Things is transforming our homes and cities.
advanced.exUz: Narsalar interneti uylarimiz va shaharlarimizni o'zgartirmoqda.

advanced.uzDef: Internet orqali odamlar bilan aloqa o'rnatish
advanced.ex: Social networking can be a great way to connect with friends and family.
advanced.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoq do'stlar va oila bilan aloqa qilishning ajoyib usuli bo'lishi mumkin.

advanced.ex: Data privacy is a major concern in the digital age.
advanced.exUz: Ma'lumotlar maxfiyligi raqamli davrda asosiy muammo hisoblanadi.

advanced.ex: The late 1990s saw a huge tech boom.
advanced.exUz: 1990-yillarning oxirlarida katta texnologiya rivoji kuzatildi.

advanced.uzDef: Internet orqali ma'lumotlarni saqlash va ularga kirish
advanced.ex: Cloud computing allows businesses to scale their operations easily.
advanced.exUz: Bulutli hisoblash korxonalarga o'z faoliyatini osonlikcha kengaytirishga imkon beradi.

advanced.ex: This new technology is a real game changer for the industry.
advanced.exUz: Bu yangi texnologiya sanoat uchun haqiqiy o'yin qoidasini o'zgartiruvchidir.

advanced.ex: He works at a tech startup developing new apps.
advanced.exUz: U yangi ilovalarni ishlab chiquvchi texnologiya startapida ishlaydi.

advanced.ex: Protecting your online identity is crucial for privacy.
advanced.exUz: Maxfiylik uchun onlayn shaxsingizni himoya qilish juda muhim.

advanced.uzDef: Texnologiya kompaniyalari aksiyalarining haddan tashqari qimmatlashuvi
advanced.ex: Many investors lost money when the tech bubble burst in 2000.
advanced.exUz: 2000-yilda texnologiya pufagi yorilganda ko'plab investorlar pul yo'qotdilar.

advanced.uzDef: Internet orqali mahsulot va xizmatlarni reklama qilish
advanced.ex: Digital marketing is essential for reaching today's consumers.
advanced.exUz: Raqamli marketing bugungi iste'molchilarga erishish uchun juda muhim.

advanced.uzDef: Texnologik muammolarni hal qilishda yordam berish
advanced.ex: I called tech support to fix my computer problem.
advanced.exUz: Kompyuterimdagi muammoni hal qilish uchun texnik yordamga qo'ng'iroq qildim.

advanced.ex: My phone died right before the meeting, go figure!
advanced.exUz: Uchrashuvdan oldin telefonim o'chib qoldi, tushunarsiz!

advanced.ex: I like to surf the web in my free time.
advanced.exUz: Bo'sh vaqtimda internetda sayr qilishni yoqtiraman.

advanced.ex: Data analytics can help businesses make better decisions.
advanced.exUz: Ma'lumotlar tahlili korxonalarga yaxshiroq qarorlar qabul qilishga yordam beradi.

advanced.ex: There have been a lot of tech layoffs recently.
advanced.exUz: Yaqinda texnologiya qisqarishlari ko'p bo'ldi.

advanced.ex: We can watch movies on demand through streaming services.
advanced.exUz: Biz oqimli xizmatlar orqali filmlarni talab bo'yicha tomosha qilishimiz mumkin.

advanced.ex: Digital transformation is changing the way businesses operate.
advanced.exUz: Raqamli transformatsiya biznesning ishlash usulini o'zgartirmoqda.

advanced.ex: I use a digital wallet to pay for things with my phone.
advanced.exUz: Men telefonim bilan narsalarga to'lash uchun raqamli hamyondan foydalanaman.

advanced.ex: I dream of living in a smart home one day.
advanced.exUz: Men bir kun kelib aqlli uyda yashashni orzu qilaman.
